test_with_columns: test the with_columns method adding computed columns via expressions, series, literals, and keyword arguments
test_with_columns_empty: test with_columns called with no arguments returns the original dataframe unchanged
test_with_columns_single_series: test with_columns on a LazyFrame adding a single named Series column
